title: Trail Cam Human Intrusion by Camera
dataSources: iNaturalist observations (`inat:observation`), moth trap sessions (`mothtrap:session`), bat detections (`batdetector:pass`), and trail-cam label events (`trailcam:label`).
app: Backyard biodiversity telemetry from iNaturalist exports, moth-trap image batches, AudioMoth bat detectors, and trail-camera AI labeling pipelines sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trailcam:label
| search label="person"
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as human_events by _time camera_id
| sort - _time
description: Tracks trail-cam human detections over time and breaks it out by camera.
value: Human detections often matter operationally as much as wildlife, especially near feeders or nesting areas.
implementation: Send trail-cam human detections events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of trail-cam human detections by camera.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how trail-cam human detections changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
